To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a DaaS layered SOA is an effective way of separating the decision modelling concern and processes modelling concern in a way that improves the scalability, maintain ability, flexibility and understand ability of both decisions and processes.
the DaaS layered SOA design provides a scalable, maintainable, flexible and understandable way of modelling decisions and processes.

“The Decision as a Service design of Decision Aware Information systems provides a scalable, flexible, and understandable way of modelling decisions as services that processes need in order to obtain their outcome.”.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a systematic way of externalising decisions from process models and the introduction of a SOA design for decision aware information systems that provides the required support for the externalisation of decisions from processes.
the separation of the concerns of process and decision modelling and the benefits of such an approach in terms of scalability and understandability.
how to separate the decision modelling concern in a Service Oriented Architecture, and how this separation can improve process decision modelling.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DaaS provides a suitable solution for tackling the separation of process and decision modelling concerns.
the DaaS design is a promising approach for the externalisation and separation of decisions from processes.

a decision as a service approach is an effective way to separate the decision modelling concern, as it provides an effective solution to the problems that arise from the integration of the decision modelling and process modelling concerns.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have provided a systematic and scalable way for separating decision modelling concern from processes modelling concern by providing the DaaS SOA design which is based on the DMN standard and provides a suitable solution for the decision modelling concern in terms of scalability and maintainability.
DaaS design provides a suitable SOA solution to tackle the decision as a service concern in a way that is independent of the process modelling concern.

the DaaS approach provides an efficient way of externalising decision modelling from process modelling and provides a clear separation of concerns, which in turn, provides a more scalable, maintainable, flexible and understandable process model.
The main takeaway from our work is that

by externalising the decision modelling concern, we can improve the scalability, maintain-ability, flexibility and the understandability of the decision modelling aspect, which in turn will improve the scalability, flexibility and understand-ability of the overall information system.
the DaaS design of decision aware information systems is a viable approach for the separation of the decisions modelling concern from the process modelling concern.
by separating decisions from processes, the process model can be simplified and decision logic can be reused across multiple processes.
